question: What post-training quantization recipe should be applied by default to every trained head before its weights ship?
objective: SMALLER STORED WEIGHTS at near-identical scores. NOT inference speed: backbone_search_v1 measured the backbone at 5-17% of end-to-end score time (22.45-24.00 s/1k tiles across six backbones), so the deploy path is decode-bound and no rung here can be justified on throughput.
written_before: any quantized weight was produced and any agreement number was computed. This file is committed in its own commit, ahead of the tooling.
moves_nothing: no production pin moves; every ACTIVE checkpoint is read-only; the big-repo deploy path stays fp32. This study decides what a FUTURE ship step does.

candidate_ladder.rule: evaluate in order, ADOPT THE SMALLEST RUNG THAT PASSES every bar below on all four heads. One default procedure; a per-head exception only where the data forces it, and then the sweep that forced it is reported.

rungs.name: fp16
rungs.spec: every floating-point tensor of the state_dict stored as float16; integer buffers (num_batches_tracked) stored verbatim. Dequantized to the source dtype at load.

rungs.name: int8
rungs.spec: weight-only, per-output-channel (dim 0) SYMMETRIC int8 for every floating tensor with ndim >= 2 (conv + linear weights, 98.0-98.4% of float params on these four heads); scale_c = max|W_c|/127 stored fp32; every other floating tensor (BN affine, biases, 1-D) stored fp16. Dequantized to fp32 at load; compute is unchanged fp32. NO activation quantization and NO backend engine (fbgemm/qnnpack/TensorRT) so the recipe re-applies in a clean-room repo with standard torch on any platform.

rungs.name: hybrid
rungs.spec: int8 as above EXCEPT named layer groups kept at fp16, chosen by a per-group sensitivity sweep (quantize one group at a time against the fp32 reference scores). Only reached if int8 fails a head's bar; the sweep is reported so the exception is attributable.

instrument_controls.inputs_actually_change: Before any score is read, the max relative weight error introduced by the rung is computed and reported per head. An exact 0.0000 agreement delta is a measurement of nothing (measurement_practice.md, 'Before pre-registering a bar, verify the instrument's inputs actually change'), so a rung whose weight error is 0 is reported as VACUOUS rather than as a pass.
instrument_controls.noise_floor: The fp32 reference is scored TWICE in the same process, and max|delta p| between the two identical passes is reported as the instrument's own noise floor. Every agreement delta below is read against it.
instrument_controls.pairing: fp32 and quantized are scored over the same rows in the same order on the same device in the same process, so decode, transform and row order cancel.
instrument_controls.round_trip: Each quantized artifact is re-read from disk after writing and its dequantized tensors are asserted bit-identical to the ones computed at write time, and a sample is re-scored through the re-read artifact. sha256 of the artifact is recorded.

yardstick.what: retrain noise on the location head
yardstick.basis: control (mnv4_conv_medium) 3-seed band of pooled PRIMARY AUC(>=3), 0.9428393 to 0.9491992, data/backbone_search/results_backbone_v1.json seed_bands_primary_auc_ge3
yardstick.used_as: 'well inside' is declared as one QUARTER of this spread, 0.0016 AUC.

location.population: PRIMARY — the 2,190 v11 eval locations that touch neither training nor a checkpoint pick (975 at >=2, 408 at >=3, 98 at >=4), the frozen backbone-search population, scored at the deploy-canonical render
location.delta_p_is_over: all K-1 = 3 cumulative rank probabilities P(>=2), P(>=3), P(>=4)

wallpaper.population: sheet D — the 197 labeled BLIND minibrot rows of 2026-08-11_wallpaper_blind_minibrot_v1. READ-ONLY use of an eval instrument; nothing anchors on it and no verdict about the head is drawn from it.
wallpaper.no_auc_bar_because: at n=197 with this tier mix an AUC delta is dominated by row noise, not by the rung. AUC is reported as descriptive.

mining.population: sheet E — the labeled BLIND render-mode rows of 2026-08-11_render_mode_blind_v1 (150 sheet rows). READ-ONLY, same standing as sheet D.

pref.population: NO committed eval instrument exists for this head — the query records and images its labels key into are gone from disk (durability_map.py, 'the PREF-HEAD JOIN'). The draw is therefore the 47 committed library records' OWN production candidate sets: every palette_candidates[] entry (12 per location, 564 frames), recolored off each location's cached field under the entry's durable coloring recipe. This is a within-location ranking head, so every quantity is within-location.
pref.record_the_draw: location_id list + variant_id list + the recorded pref_rank, written into the agreement record.

reported_per_head_regardless_of_verdict: artifact size before/after in bytes and MB
max relative weight error of the rung
every metric above, with its population count
honesty_rules: A bar is failed if the measured value is on the wrong side of it, whatever its margin; no bar is relaxed after a number is seen.
If a rung fails on one head only, the DEFAULT is the smallest rung that passes everywhere and that head takes the named exception — not a lowered bar.
Numbers carry population and basis. Agreement is reported as a count over its denominator, never as a bare percentage.
